title: test_login_form_accessibility
description: Verify that GET /login returns a 200 status with the login form HTML and does not require authentication.

title: test_login_submission_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /login with valid credentials returns a 302 redirect to /accueil-patient and sets an authentication session cookie.

title: test_login_submission_with_invalid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /login with invalid credentials returns a 302 redirect back to /login with an error flash message or 422 validation errors.

title: test_logout_functionality
description: Verify that POST /logout with a valid auth session clears the session and returns a 302 redirect to /login.

title: test_access_accueil_patient_with_authentication
description: Verify that GET /accueil-patient with a valid auth session returns a 200 status with the AccueilPatient Livewire page.

title: test_access_accueil_patient_without_authentication
description: Verify that GET /accueil-patient without authentication returns a 302 redirect to /login.

title: test_access_patients_list_with_authentication
description: Verify that GET /patients with a valid auth session returns a 200 status with the patients list HTML.

title: test_access_patients_create_form_with_authentication
description: Verify that GET /patients/create with a valid auth session returns a 200 status with the patient creation form HTML and Livewire component mounts.

title: test_access_patients_routes_without_authentication
description: Verify that GET /patients and GET /patients/create without authentication return a 302 redirect to /login.

title: test_access_rendez_vous_list_with_authentication
description: Verify that GET /rendez-vous with a valid auth session returns a 200 status with the rendez-vous list Livewire page.
